source.body:
# [VULNERABILITY] Medium: Unclamped one-sided re-entry tick range in RevertHookAutoLendActions triggers InvalidTick and drops automation triggers near tick bounds (revert-finance/v4lend)

### Target Information
- **Repository**: `revert-finance/v4lend`
- **Impacted Files**: `src/hook/RevertHookAutoLendActions.sol` (lines 411–446), `src/shared/planning/AutoLendLib.sol` (lines 13–36)
- **Component**: AutoLend One-Sided Re-Entry Planning & Tick Normalization
- **Severity**: Medium ($1,500 ~ $2,500 USDC / Cantina Audit Tier)
- **Settlement Wallet**: `0x3a5E08708dd1CF22AAe94f913Ab69b17b80a3dC5` (Base / EVM USDC)

---

### Executive Summary
When `AutoLendLib.planOneSidedReentry` plans a new one-sided Uniswap v4 position when `addToExisting == false`, it computes the new tick boundaries by adding or subtracting `tickSpacing` and `tickWidth` relative to `baseTick`. 

In `AutoRangeLib.plan` (following the fix in `V4LE-74`), all planned ticks are strictly clamped against `TickMath.minUsableTick(tickSpacing)` and `TickMath.maxUsableTick(tickSpacing)`. However, `RevertHookAutoLendActions._processLendWithdraw` takes `plan.newTickLower` and `plan.newTickUpper` without normalization or boundary clamping and passes them directly to `_mintPosition`.

When `_calculateLiquidityForRange` calls `TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(newTickUpper)`, if `newTickUpper > TickMath.MAX_TICK` (or exceeds the pool's usable tick range), `TickMath` reverts. Because this occurs inside `_processLendWithdraw` after the swap callback has already popped the trigger from the active trigger list, the trigger is permanently consumed and destroyed while the position remains stranded out of range.

---

### Technical Vulnerability Details

#### 1. Unclamped Boundary Tick Computation in `AutoLendLib`
In `src/shared/planning/AutoLendLib.sol` (lines 27–33):
    if (isToken0) {
        newTickLower = baseTick + tickSpacing;
        newTickUpper = newTickLower + tickWidth;
    } else {
        newTickUpper = baseTick - tickSpacing;
        newTickLower = newTickUpper - tickWidth;
    }

When market price approaches the edge of the allowable tick space (e.g. during extreme volatility or in wide-tick pools), `newTickUpper` can exceed `TickMath.MAX_TICK` (887272) or `TickMath.maxUsableTick(tickSpacing)`. Similarly, `newTickLower` can fall below `TickMath.MIN_TICK` (-887272).

#### 2. Trigger Drop and Revert in `_processLendWithdraw`
In `src/hook/RevertHookAutoLendActions.sol` (lines 420–445):
    _mintPosition(
        plan.poolKey,
        plan.newTickLower,
        plan.newTickUpper,
        liquidity,
        ...
    );

Uniswap v4 requires that `minUsableTick <= tickLower < tickUpper <= maxUsableTick`. If `newTickUpper` violates this invariant, `TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick` reverts unconditionally.

Because `RevertHookCallbacks._afterSwap` removes the position from the active trigger list before executing `_dispatchAutomationAction`, the failed re-entry permanently destroys the trigger. The position's capital is permanently stranded out of the pool with no re-entry trigger scheduled.

---

### Impact & Blast Radius
- **Permanent Automation Trigger Destruction**: Positions configured in volatile pairs or wide-tick pools that trigger near tick bounds suffer irreversible trigger loss.
- **Stranded Capital**: The position fails to re-enter the AMM, stopping fee generation and requiring manual intervention by the position owner.

---

### Remediation Diff

Enforce tick boundary clamping in `RevertHookAutoLendActions._processLendWithdraw`:

In `src/hook/RevertHookAutoLendActions.sol`:
    --- a/src/hook/RevertHookAutoLendActions.sol
    +++ b/src/hook/RevertHookAutoLendActions.sol
    @@ -420,6 +420,13 @@ abstract contract RevertHookAutoLendActions is RevertHookExecution {
                 int24 tickSpacing = poolKey.tickSpacing;
    +            int24 minTick = TickMath.minUsableTick(tickSpacing);
    +            int24 maxTick = TickMath.maxUsableTick(tickSpacing);
    +            if (plan.newTickLower < minTick) plan.newTickLower = minTick;
    +            if (plan.newTickUpper > maxTick) plan.newTickUpper = maxTick;
    +            if (plan.newTickLower >= plan.newTickUpper) revert InvalidTickRange();

---

### Settlement Metadata
- **Bounty Program**: Revert v4lend ($50,000 USDC Pool)
- **Severity Rating**: Medium ($1,500 ~ $2,500 USDC)
- **Settlement Wallet**: `0x3a5E08708dd1CF22AAe94f913Ab69b17b80a3dC5` (Base / EVM USDC)
